This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. The [[humanoid]] species was distinguished by their [[Color|dark]], almost greenish skin, as well as light tips at the ends of their fingers.<ref name="AOTC" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="EP2Date">{{FilmDate|II}}</ref> at least two members of this species were associated with the [[Galactic Senate]], present at the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]].<ref name="AOTC" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars:'' Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], written by both [[George Lucas]] and [[Jonathan Hales]], and directed by the former.<ref name="AOTC" /> When asked about another unidentified species, [[Leland Chee]] revealed that he had no additional information regarding any of the unidentified species only ever seen in the background of the Senate Building, going as far as to state he lumped them all together under one collective entry within the [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Discord">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-09-23|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1420092823541387354|archivefile=File:SenateSpecies-HolocronSpecies.png}}</ref>
